Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our MAP discussion, I captured the immediate dependencies we need on Cobalt's side to get the POC environment greenlit. See summary below and attached draft MAP (redwood-poc-map-v0.3.pdf). Please confirm owners and approximate ETA so we can lock the pilot start date.

Summary (high level):
- VPC peering / Transit: Cobalt networking team to approve peering with Redwood-managed VPC and provide route confirmation.
- IP allowlist: Cobalt to add Redwood egress ranges (attached spreadsheet) and confirm NAT behavior for ephemeral workers.
- SSO / SAML: Configure SAML IdP entry for Redwood (we support standard ADFS/Okta/OneLogin flows). SSO required for test users only during POC.
- Secrets / KMS: Provide either (a) customer-managed KMS key for data-at-rest encryption, or (b) approve Redwood-managed AES key with restricted access.

Requested next steps:
1) Please assign an owner for each item above and reply with estimated completion date.
2) If you need a short handoff call with our infra team, we can do a 30-min working session next week.

Attachments: redwood-poc-map-v0.3.pdf, cobalt-network-ranges.xlsx, network-diagram_v1.png

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a technical checklist from Karthik to make implementation simpler.

—

Hi all — quick technical checklist to make the Tuesday call productive. I’ve labelled owners on our side; please copy these into your MAP so we have single owners per task.

Technical checklist (POC scope):
1) VPC peering & routes (owner: Alex / Cobalt) — deliverable: peering request, route table entries, confirmation of no 10.0.0.0/8 overlap. Deadline suggested: 2026-11-20.
2) IP allowlist (owner: Priya / Cobalt) — deliverable: sheet with CIDRs to add; Redwood egress ranges included in attachment. If you prefer dynamic egress, confirm NAT gateway details. Deadline: 2026-11-15.
3) SSO / SAML (owner: Cobalt Okta admin; Redwood contact: Karthik) — deliverable: SP metadata (will attach), test user list (up to 5), and assertion attributes (email, groups). Action: Cobalt to create test Okta app and provide IdP metadata. Deadline: 2026-11-12.
4) Secrets / KMS (owner: Priya / procurement; Redwood contact: Ben) — options: customer CMK (provide ARN and grant) OR Redwood-managed key for POC. Deliverable: procurement decision + KMS grant if CMK chosen. Deadline: 2026-11-18.
5) Nightly connectivity smoke test (owner: Redwood infra — Rishi) — deliverable: simple curl/handshake logs sent to Cobalt on first 3 nights after peering. Start: first day after peering is established.

Attachments I’ll bring to the call: SP metadata XML, short runbook (2 pages) with sample cURL checks, and an updated network diagram.

Lauren — I set the MAP milestones in the attached redwood-poc-map-v0.3.pdf. Alex/Priya — if the deadlines above are tight, propose alternatives in reply.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
